items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: people like Condon or Wild Bill Davison or King Oliver or Louis Armstrong, haven’t been recognized

ctx.x: And sometimes I feel like that works against it because if it’s so happy it’s not really serious. And maybe it’s not worthy of study or, I don’t know either.

Well I would agree with you and that’s probably why a lot of what we would consider icons of the music, you know people like Condon or Wild Bill Davison or King Oliver or Louis Armstrong, haven’t been recognized — except Louis was world famous — but I mean have not been recognized outside of a small group of the public for the type of musician and quality musician that they were. And I think that’s really too bad. I mentioned Wild Bill Davison to somebody who was a Springsteen fan for example. He said, “Who?…
In the years you were here, obviously some members graduated and stuff. Was there competition to get into the Catatonic Five?
